words.meaning: The gentle, ambient luminescence that seems to radiate from a masterpiece of visual art
words.sentence1: The quiet studio was illuminated by the golden pictolume of her latest canvas. (The quiet studio was illuminated by the golden painted glow of her latest canvas.)
words.sentence2: Connoisseurs gathered around the frame, mesmerized by its sublime pictolume. (Connoisseurs gathered around the frame, mesmerized by its sublime artistic radiance.)

words.meaning: A brushstroke of pure light that brings transcendent beauty to a canvas
words.sentence1: El maestro agrego un delicado pincelluz sobre el rostro del retrato. (The master added a delicate stroke of light onto the portrait's face.)
words.sentence2: Cada pincelluz en esta obra refleja una serenidad infinita. (Every stroke of light in this artwork reflects infinite serenity.)

words.meaning: The deep, poetic soul captured within a fine piece of visual or sculpted art
words.sentence1: Cette fresque ancienne possede une peinturame d'une elegance rare. (This ancient fresco possesses a painted soul of rare elegance.)
words.sentence2: L'artiste a infuse toute sa joie dans la peinturame de sa nouvelle toile. (The artist infused all his joy into the artistic soul of his new canvas.)

words.meaning: The profound aesthetic radiance emitted by an evocative artistic creation
words.sentence1: Das Kunstleuchten der Skulptur zog jeden Betrachter magisch an. (The artistic radiance of the sculpture magically attracted every viewer.)
words.sentence2: Im Daemmerlicht entfaltete das Gemaelde ein geheimnisvolles Kunstleuchten. (In the twilight, the painting unfolded a mysterious artistic radiance.)

words.meaning: The blooming aura of exquisite harmony and aesthetic elegance in an artwork
words.sentence1: Sono byoubu kara wa fukai bigaensho ga tadayotteiru. (A profound blooming aura of artistic grace drifts from that folding screen.)
words.sentence2: Gaka wa kyanbasu ni shizen no bigaensho wo utsushidashita. (The painter captured nature's blooming artistic grace onto the canvas.)

words.meaning: The sublime intersection where natural charm is elevated into timeless artistic perfection
words.sentence1: Passeggiare tra i portici di Firenze rivela una continua bellezzarte. (Strolling among the arcades of Florence reveals a continuous artistic beauty.)
words.sentence2: La scultura marmorea esprimeva la quintessenza della bellezzarte rinascimentale. (The marble sculpture expressed the quintessence of Renaissance artistic beauty.)

words.meaning: The enchanting rhythm and lingering aesthetic charm found in fine art
words.sentence1: Zhe fu shanshuihua liutang zhe kongling de meiyiyun. (This landscape painting flows with an ethereal artistic charm.)
words.sentence2: Guanzhong bei ta wudao zhong de meiyiyun shengsheng d Open. (The audience was deeply moved by the aesthetic artistic charm in her dance.)

words.meaning: The gentle, undulating texture of visual beauty and artistic grace
words.sentence1: Baekja-ui pyomyeon-eseo goyohan mibitgyeol-i neukkyeojinda. (A tranquil wave of artistic beauty is felt on the surface of the white porcelain.)
words.sentence2: Geu hwapok-eun nunbusin mibitgyeol-lo gadeuk cha itda. (That canvas is brimming with a dazzling wave of aesthetic beauty.)

words.meaning: The shimmering spark of pure elegance and artistic brilliance
words.sentence1: Kompoul chamlak nih ban banyhchheanh silpaprich yang pitbrakad. (This summit sculpture radiated an authentic artistic sparkle.)
words.sentence2: Tukchet robos kot ban reykray doysa silpaprich ney teptkosol. (His heart rejoiced because of the artistic brilliance of fine talent.)

words.meaning: The captivating luster and refined brilliance produced by masterful craftsmanship
words.sentence1: Die kunsglans van die nuwe muurskildering het almal betower. (The artistic luster of the new mural enchanted everyone.)
words.sentence2: Sy soek altyd na daardie ongerepte kunsglans in elke skepping. (She always searches for that pristine artistic luster in every creation.)
